description: This file contains functions and types for managing and building model rows, loading model registries and catalogs, and filtering models within a list management context in a TypeScript project related to model handling.

methods.name: matchesRowFilter
methods.description: Checks if a model matches the given row filter based on provider and local URL criteria.

methods.name: buildRow
methods.description: Constructs a ModelRow object from a model, key, and context, optionally allowing provider fallback.

methods.name: loadListModelRegistry
methods.description: Loads a model registry and discovers model keys.

methods.name: appendDiscoveredRows
methods.description: Appends model rows for discovered models that pass filtering and suppression rules.

methods.name: appendCatalogSupplementRows
methods.description: Adds catalog entries as model rows if they are not already seen and match filters.

methods.name: appendConfiguredRows
methods.description: Adds configured entries as model rows, respecting filter conditions.
